channel.title: Gabon - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Gabon, every source cited.

item.title: Gabon health ministry warns of late stroke arrivals
item.description: Nearly 80% of stroke patients reach hospitals beyond the critical window for treatment.

item.title: Gabon signs Accra Convention to speed up trade
item.description: The UN agreement aims to digitize transport documents, cut costs, and simplify import-export operations.

item.title: Gabon seeks balanced economic partnership with Russia
item.description: Vice-President Hermann Immongault called for mutual interests and state sovereignty at the Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow.

item.title: Gabon votes to lift US embargo on Cuba
item.description: The UN General Assembly voted on October 28, 2026, to end the US embargo on Cuba.

item.title: Gabon hosts Congo Basin civil society for COP31 talks
item.description: Over 50 participants from six countries met in Libreville to forge a common stance on climate finance and local rights.
